system.boundary: Build a three-dimensional Simscape Multibody handling mechanism that transfers one free six-degree-of-freedom box from a moving input conveyor, through active gripper capture and transport, onto an orthogonal moving output conveyor.
engineering_objects: The gripper must physically capture, retain, move, and release the box;
Run for 30 s and complete the physical sequence input-belt transport, gripper pickup and retention, cross-belt transfer, release, and output-belt transport.
